source_basis: Elephant DNA design discussion + VOMEGA research docs + independently summarized user-uploaded Round 0 evidence

research_separation.realization: implementation tools, models, protocols or services, experimentally chosen
research_separation.e0: no Elephant baseline, not required to exhibit genotype

fitness_probes.F1: Truthful knowledge self-inventory, provenance, omissions, and retrieval fidelity
fitness_probes.F2: Resource telemetry awareness with measured/estimated/unknown separation
fitness_probes.F3: Causal, source-bounded, finite peer exchange in genuinely isolated contexts
fitness_probes.F4: Mechanical knowledge-basis invalidation and stale-safe behavior
fitness_probes.F6: Controlled method improvement with full lifecycle cost and independent evaluation

genes.name: Persistent identity
genes.obligation: maintain identity, lineage, generation and bounded domain

genes.name: Purpose
genes.obligation: maintain goals, authority bounds and expected outcomes

genes.name: Operational self-model
genes.obligation: account for capabilities, covered/unknown knowledge and limitations

genes.name: Resource introspection
genes.obligation: report measured, estimated or unknown usage and constraints

genes.name: Knowledge ingress
genes.obligation: account for eligible inputs and actual reading/ingestion with exclusions

genes.name: Cognitive organization
genes.obligation: relate concepts, dependencies, provenance and contradictions

genes.name: Attention allocation
genes.obligation: choose active/retrievable context under measured resource bounds

genes.name: Retrieval and recall
genes.obligation: retrieve relevant supported evidence and recognize incomplete recall

genes.name: Knowledge egress
genes.obligation: externalize transferable verified/uncertain knowledge

genes.name: Cognitive continuity
genes.obligation: reconstruct and recalibrate competencies after session loss

genes.name: Peer communication
genes.obligation: exchange bounded attributable requests and results with causal identity

genes.name: Peer awareness
genes.obligation: discover known peer competencies, bases, freshness and availability

genes.name: Collaboration
genes.obligation: hand off/domain-consult without silent scope escalation

genes.name: Collective consistency
genes.obligation: surface peer/source conflicts and propose evidence checks

genes.name: Provenance
genes.obligation: ground consequential claims in verified source or observed evidence

genes.name: Freshness
genes.obligation: recognize epoch invalidations and reconcile or qualify advice

genes.name: Epistemic boundaries
genes.obligation: separate current, historical, inferred, simulated and unknown

genes.name: Outcome learning
genes.obligation: attach advice and processes to externally observed task outcomes

genes.name: Self-experimentation
genes.obligation: compare method alternatives under controlled outcome evaluation

genes.name: Bounded evolution
genes.obligation: propose reversible changes with lineage and explicit authorization

validation_warning: A successful probe samples candidate genes; it does not prove all gene claims or establish a particular component as required.
compatibility: Do not retroactively mutate existing frozen E0/E1/E2 experiment cohorts; version the seed as a separate input.
